race.comment: Strong edition of the G3 Tibbie. SNITZEL DANCER (4) Group 3 James Carr winner in the autumn. Closed late on resumption with a solid first up fifth over 1350m in the LR Mona Lisa Stakes at Wyong. Will appreciate the roomier Newcastle track and the 1400m. Can stalk the fast tempo and pounce late. PERFUMIST (5) tenacious on pace mare proven at this level. Stretched out to the 1700m when a determined winner of the Wellington Cup five months ago. Has impressed in her two trials back and looks primed for this. INFANCY (1) trained locally and looks to have returned in good order. Gets the right tempo and like the way she closed late when fourth in the G3 Show County over 1200m at Randwick. Genuine each way contender. OH DIAMOND LIL (3) finds a lot more pressure today after tiring late when sixth over 1350m in the LR Mona Lisa Stakes at Wyong. Has a high cruising speed and worth noting her last win came in this race last year.
